discovery: Development of massively parallel next-generation DNA sequencing (sequencing by synthesis with reversible terminators on clonally amplified clusters)
rationale: Solexa/Illumina sequencing-by-synthesis is a chemistry-driven invention: reversible-terminator fluorescent nucleotides and surface cluster amplification. It cut genome sequencing costs by orders of magnitude and transformed biology and medicine. The trio has already won the Breakthrough Prize and the Millennium Technology Prize. The committee often alternates between materials and molecular-biology chemistry. After metal-organic frameworks in 2025, a biochemical tools prize fits that pattern.
